name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.96: fridge door openers now work and scale to the model. The Overview Open door action was wrongly wired to the coil restock flow; it now enqueues fridge_open_door with the cabinet, and renders one button per cabinet the model has (single = one Open door, double = Open door A and Open door B). Kiosk screen designer is promoted from a header link to a main tab, shown on coil machines only (fridges have no hero-tile screen). Cumulative over v5.95.
